reconstructed_theorem_text: Define a family of Borel measures rho_n on the full real orthogonal groups O(n), for every natural number n including zero, by rho_n := Measure.haarMeasure(top : PositiveCompacts(O(n))). Here O(n) = {A in R^(n x n) : A^T A = I} has the inherited finite real matrix topology and its Borel sigma-algebra, top is the entire compact group, and the actual Haar construction is normalized to assign that entire group mass one. This displayed expression is a definition of a measure-valued function of n, rather than a separate theorem asserting uniqueness.

domains: The function domain is all natural numbers, including zero; its value at n is a Borel measure on the full real orthogonal group O(n), with real Fin n by Fin n matrices and inherited finite real matrix topology. O(0) is a singleton. There is no determinant-one restriction.
quantifiers: A function is defined for arbitrary n in the natural numbers. The expression has no existential quantifier and no quantified comparison with other measures.
assumptions: No caller premises beyond the natural number argument. The approved context provides the compact, nonempty, Hausdorff and second countable group structure needed for this actual Haar construction.
conclusion: The resulting value is precisely Measure.haarMeasure normalized on the entire group; its normalization set has mass one. The displayed term itself is a measure-valued definition, not a proposition with a proof conclusion.
scopes: Each n selects the full O(n) and its top positive compact set. The constructor is explicit rather than an unspecified choice of a measure. No separate uniqueness, pushforward equality, right-invariance theorem or sampling algorithm appears in this expression.
